constants.description: Approximate age of the universe at last scattering, shown as the widely quoted round figure. Its origin is the WMAP first-year best fit, t_dec = 379 (+8, −7) kyr (Bennett et al. 2003, Table 3). Current values are slightly lower: the PDG 2026 Big-Bang Cosmology review (Sec. 22.4.1) gives about 370,000 years, and integrating the Friedmann equation with the Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing+BAO parameters to z* = 1089.80 gives about 372,000 years. Flagged for the science reviewer.

constants.description: Fraction of primordial atoms that are helium, derived from Y_P = 0.245 ± 0.003. With atomic masses m(4He)/m(1H) = 4.00260325413 / 1.00782503223 = 3.97153 (NIST), He/H by number = (Y_P / 3.97153) / (1 − Y_P) = 0.08171, so f_He = 0.08171 / 1.08171 = 0.07554. Error propagation: df/dY = f(1 − f) / (Y(1 − Y)) = 0.3775, times 0.003 gives ± 0.0011. Trace nuclei neglected.
